decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - Reason: The proposed variation of the condition to allow minor alterations to the approved scheme 01048/181-183/P7 would not harm the appearance of the street scene or neighbours' living conditions, would provide acceptable living conditions, and would accord with the Council's traffic, parking and servicing standards. The proposal complies with adopted Unitary Development Plan policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), H.4.1 (Housing Standards and Guidelines), H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) and T.1.4 (Car and Cycle Parking and Servicing Facilities For Developments).

Condition : 2 - Condition 3 (Approved Plans) of permission 01048/181-183/P7 should be varied to allow for: the erection of a single-storey pitched roof side extension to the detached house at Plot 7, insertion of 3 rooflight windows in roofslope and creation of additional bedroom in roof space of plot 11, changes to the arrangement of the windows on the rear and side elevations of Plot 11/12/13 and Plots 14-18, relocation of bin and cycle stores at plots 11-18 and changes to car-parking at plots 12-18 of permission 01048/181-183/P7 dated 30th June 2005 for 18 residential units.
description: Variation of condition 3 (Approved Plans) to erect a single-storey pitched roof side extension to the detached house at Plot 7, insertion of 3 rooflight windows in roofslope and creation of additional bedroom in roof space of plot 11, changes to the arrangement of the windows on the rear and side elevations of Plot 11/12/13 and Plots 14-18, relocation of bin and cycle stores at plots 11-18 and changes to car-parking at plots 12-18 of permission 01048/181-183/P7 dated 30th June 2005 for 18 residential units.
